footer.recording: Ma num ra haf nnoi hynne ede her. Sor na hymme azl yorr selena sor.
home.intro.title: Her memora
home.intro.body: Ma num ra haf crushue oz knawa, en sial crushue, en sial wart, en na fitouva cyurio. Ma num ra aulla erlla sor tes omni.
home.works.title: Crushue
home.notes.title: Sial wart
common.empty: Ma num ra na haf wart ede her.
works.title: Crushue
works.description: Wee ki ra crushue omni sos knawa. Gral memora aulla tes omn ides.
notes.title: Sial wart
notes.description: Wee ki ra linen omn vit, en omn knawa, en sial wart.
about.title: Whou
about.description: Ma num ra pagle whou haf her memora, en whai sor irs.
about.keeper.title: Whou haf her memora
about.keeper.lede: Ma num ra irs walasye whou melenas colmask, en wart, en hymmnos, en grlanza. Endoretic irs omn memora mea.
about.interests.title: Dsier
about.origin.title: Whai mea crushue memora
about.origin.statement: Was au wa sial omni whou mea melenas naja ween ides.
about.origin.body: Fou jyel ra pic cerchio oz crushue omn memora sos nx crushue. Fou jyel ra pic omni whou mea melenas naja ween ides. Ma num ra crushue nx omni sos khal memora oz ides futare, en sor chs folten wart mea.
about.fragments.label: Whalt irs ween sor
about.fragments.body: Wart oz ides whou vit futare tou foul en hiew; colmask en wart whou ferda ween ides dyya; grlanza oz hynne whou chs elle nnoi rinc oz ides. Llizz sor na haf zi cerchio won dor.
about.purpose.title: Whai omn memora
about.purpose.body: Ma zweie ra riomo nnoi dor tes crushue, en sial wart, en na fitouva crushue. Sor col khal omn cyurio, den na syunaht sor won erlla dor. Marst sor re viss ween futare.
about.elsewhere.title: Ther dor
credits.title: Repoear
credits.description: Ma zweie ra haf gral colmask ween her dor, en rinc sor tes omn ides, en tes wart oz spitze, en tes hynne oz whou crushue sor, en tes gral karf.
credits.field.creator: Whou crushue
credits.software.title: Cyurio
credits.software.body: Ma num ra crushue her memora viela Astro en TypeScript. Gral raudl oz sor irs ween nnoi memora.
credits.typeface.title: Colmask oz wart
credits.typeface.body: Her colmask oz wart chs elle crushue oz ferx, en sor karf gral wart tes hymmnos colmask. Sor na haf wart oz spitze. Ma num ra drone sor goa aiph yorr aulla her colmask, en her memora irs gral van na sor.
credits.homage.title: Tes whou pomb her wart
credits.homage.body: Was yea ra repoear Akira Tsuchiya, whou pomb Hymmnos sos Ar tonelico. Wee touwaka ra vit wart whou haf enesse ween omn cyurio, en sor foul irs erra.
credits.homage.note: endoretic.cc irs omn memora oz nnoi walasye, en sor na irs rinc tes Gust Co., Ltd. nor Koei Tecmo Games Co., Ltd. Hymmnos en Ar tonelico irs omn oz whou pomb sor.
notfound.title: Hynne ftt
notfound.body: Nn num ra na haf sor memora ween her.

layer.hint: Ma num ra aulla wart oz sor aiph yorr vit sor.
